name: Rechenzentrum Ostschweiz (RZO) Gossau
developer: Rechenzentrum Ostschweiz AG (SAK / St. Galler Stadtwerke)
notes: Colocation datacenter at Gossau SG (second site Gais AR rated Tier IV per SAK); ~1 MW per directory; regional MSP/enterprise hosting for eastern Switzerland.

name: STACK ZUR02 Beringen (ex-Safe Host SH5)
notes: Hyperscale facility at Beringen SH (Industriestrasse area); building topped out 2025 per Baxtel; formerly Safe Host SH5; waste-heat feasibility study by Amstein+Walthert; permit backbone per CH methodology (2021-07-20 cantonal permit, Amtsblatt GB Nr. 862).

name: Enka Beringen data center
notes: Schaffhauser AZ (2026-08-10) reports two data centers planned for Beringen by Turkish contractor Enka Inşaat; holding Enka Investement AG founded in Neuhausen, to move to Beringen once complete.

name: Datacenter Thurgau (EKT AG)
notes: Colocation datacenter built into/expanded EKT Unterwerk Frauenfeld West; ground-breaking 2017-10-16; 99.982% availability; utility-owned (EKT AG).

name: Tinext DC-1 (Lugano)
notes: Directory-listed colocation facility in Lugano TI; part of small Ticino colocation market (Tinext, GOLINE, Swisscolocation).

name: GOLINE SA data center (Lugano)
notes: Directory-listed primary Ticino colocation provider; regional hosting for Lugano/Bellinzona market.

name: Swisscolocation SA (Ticino)
notes: Tier III colocation/rack-housing provider in Ticino per official site; serves mission-critical ICT customers.

name: Safe Host SH2 (Gland)
notes: Switzerland's largest carrier-neutral colo at Gland VD; +18 MW IT capacity extension contracted with Webuild/CSC (announced 2021-06-30); dual grid feed, PUE 1.3-1.8.

name: STACK Gland campus (SH1/SH3/SH4)
notes: Gland VD campus alongside SH2: SH1 (older facility, hosting since 2002-era), SH3/SH4 newer builds completing STACK Switzerland network; marketed as Geneva-area (GEN02A per directory); renewable-powered.

name: Etat du Valais data center (Sierre)
notes: Public tender (2023-02-17) for new construction including a second computing centre (centre de calcul) in Sierre ensuring continuity of the main Sion facility; public-sector DR infrastructure.

name: DATAWIRE ZG01 (Zug)
notes: Independently owned datacenter and dedicated-server provider in canton Zug; leading local DC services provider.

name: CONVOTIS datacenter Zug (ex-Acdalis)
notes: Carrier-neutral datacenter in Zug operated by CONVOTIS (formerly Acdalis Datacenter); 2026 legal-structure simplification reported by IT-Markt.

name: WWZ Rechenzentrum (Zug)
notes: Utility (WWZ) colocation datacenter in Zug; rooftop solar PV (375 modules) covers 100% of on-site operating power.

name: Equinix Zurich (ZH2/ZH3, Josefstrasse)
notes: Equinix Zurich facilities (ZH2; ZH at Josefstrasse 225 fka ICT Center); 41+ networks, peering hub; part of Equinix Switzerland portfolio incl. Geneva.

name: Digital Realty ZUR1/ZUR2/ZUR3 (Glattbrugg)
notes: Interxion-era campus at Glattbrugg (Saegereistrasse 35; Baeulerwisenstrasse 4, ZUR2); multi-building carrier hub near Zurich airport.

name: NTT Zurich 1 (ZRH1, Ruemlang)
notes: NTT Ruemlang facility (Hofwisenstrasse); ~6,500 m2 per NTT factsheet; methodology cites 10,500+ m2 / 20 MW IT load; SwissIX PoP on site.

name: Green Metro-Campus Zurich (Dielsdorf)
notes: 46,000 m2 campus; DC M operational (Dec 2022), DC N and O construction start Oct 2023 (11,600 m2, ~4,000 racks, up to 160,000 IT systems); waste-heat district heating partnership with Dielsdorf.

name: Green Datacenter Zurich West 4 (Dielsdorf)
notes: Fourth data center on Dielsdorf Metro-Campus; construction started, commissioning planned 2026 (Baublatt 2024-08-26).

name: Green Zurich City (Schlieren)
notes: Zurich West campus at Unterrohrstrasse 4, 8952 Schlieren; expanded 2020 with 5,500 m2 DC space.

name: STACK ZUR01 (Rafz)
notes: STACK Zurich-north facility at Rafz ZH per methodology/Baxtel context; part of STACK Switzerland portfolio (ZUR01/ZUR02/ZUR03); verify status on operator page.

name: AtlasEdge Zurich ZRH001 (Badenerstrasse 820)
notes: Edge colocation facility in Zurich (retrofit at Badenerstrasse 820, 8048); Tier 3 equivalent; PeeringDB fac/4086.

name: Vantage Zurich (Glattfelden)
notes: Vantage's second Swiss data center north of Zurich in Glattfelden; ~21,000 m2 (226,000 sq ft) two-storey facility per Baxtel; verify construction status.

name: Templus Zurich ZUR1 (Altstetten)
notes: 5.8 MW facility in Altstetten, Zurich; 13 km from airport, rail-connected; directory-listed.
